name: Creator LMS – WordPress LMS Plugin for Coaches & Course Creators
author: WPFunnels

sections.description:
Creator LMS is the best free WordPress LMS plugin for coaches, consultants, and online course creators. Launch group coaching programs, sell courses, and build an engaged learning community — all inside WordPress, with zero monthly fees and no WooCommerce required.

Trusted by 100+ coaches and educators worldwide. Rated ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5 stars on WordPress.org.

The core plugin is 100% free forever — unlimited courses, unlimited students, native Stripe checkout, quizzes, and certificates included at no cost.

🚀 Live Demo | 📘 Documentation | 🎥 Video Tutorials | 🎬 Setup Tutorial | 💁‍♂️ Facebook Community | 🗺️ Roadmap

Why Coaches Choose Creator LMS

Most WordPress LMS plugins are built for universities and corporate training. Creator LMS is built for coaches who need to sell, scale, and engage — without complex tech or expensive monthly platforms.

Creator LMS is the go-to WordPress coaching plugin for:

  • 🧑‍💼 Life coaches selling 1:1 and group programs
  • 💼 Business coaches running cohort-based masterminds
  • 💪 Fitness & health coaches running subscription programs
  • 🎓 Online educators building course libraries
  • 🤝 Consultants packaging expertise into sellable courses
  • 🏢 Agencies building LMS sites for clients

Six reasons coaches pick Creator LMS over everything else:

  1. Cohort-based learning (Pro) — Students start together, progress together. Creates accountability, higher completion, and justifies premium pricing.
  2. Built-in community (Pro) — Students connect, ask questions, and support each other — no BuddyPress, no Facebook Groups.
  3. AI course builder (Pro) — Describe your coaching topic and AI generates a complete course outline in minutes.
  4. Native checkout — Sell coaching programs with Stripe or Mollie. No WooCommerce. No cart abandonment.
  5. Memberships & subscriptions (Pro) — Monthly or yearly coaching memberships for predictable recurring revenue.
  6. One-click upsells (Pro) — Increase revenue per student with post-purchase upsell offers, no redirect needed.

🎯 Popular Use Cases for Coaches

Group Coaching Programs
Run structured group coaching with cohorts — students enroll, start on a set date, and move through your curriculum as a group. Perfect for high-ticket coaching offers.

Self-Paced Online Coaching Courses
Package your coaching methodology into a self-paced course. Students access lessons anytime, complete quizzes, and earn certificates to share.

Coaching Memberships
Monthly or yearly memberships that unlock your full course library, community access, and new content drops. Predictable recurring revenue without per-sale hustle.

Bootcamp & Workshop Programs
Intensive time-limited programs with cohorts, live session scheduling, and community discussion for peer accountability and support.

Free Lead Magnet Courses
Offer a free introductory course to build your email list, then convert students to paid coaching programs with one-click upsell offers.

Corporate & Team Training
Deliver employee training for business clients. Track team progress, issue completion certificates, and manage bulk enrollments.

🆓 Best Free WordPress LMS Plugin

Creator LMS offers more in its free version than most paid WordPress LMS plugins. No trial. No credit card. Free forever.

Free version includes:
– ✅ Unlimited courses, lessons, and students
– ✅ Native Stripe and Mollie checkout — no WooCommerce
– ✅ Quiz builder with 6+ question types
– ✅ Certificate builder with verification
– ✅ Gutenberg, Elementor, and Bricks Builder support
– ✅ Multiple lesson types (video, audio, text, downloads)
– ✅ Student progress tracking and analytics
– ✅ Course categories, tags, and prerequisites
– ✅ Custom video player (removes YouTube/Vimeo branding)
– ✅ Student dashboard and profile management

Creator LMS Pro unlocks:
– Cohort-based learning for group coaching programs
– Built-in community platform
– AI course builder
– Gamification (badges, leaderboards, points)
– One-click upsells and down-sells
– Memberships and subscriptions
– Advanced email automation (Mail Mint)
– Content protection (screen recording prevention)
– Additional payment gateways (PayPal, Razorpay, Authorize.net)
– Advanced analytics and reporting

Creator LMS vs. Kajabi, Teachable, LearnDash & More

The best Kajabi and Teachable alternative for WordPress coaches and course creators.

Kajabi costs $149–$399/month and takes a revenue cut. Teachable charges per transaction. Creator LMS runs on your own WordPress site — one-time Pro cost, zero revenue share, 100% data ownership.

Creator LMS vs. Kajabi

Kajabi charges $149–$399/month forever, plus revenue sharing on lower plans. Creator LMS is a one-time Pro purchase on your own WordPress site. You get cohort-based learning, a built-in community platform, AI course generation, and one-click upsells — everything Kajabi offers, without the monthly platform fee or data lock-in.

  • Kajabi: $149–$399/month + revenue share
  • Creator LMS Pro: one-time cost, no revenue share
  • Your student data stays on your own server — not locked in a SaaS platform

Creator LMS vs. Teachable

Teachable charges per-transaction fees on lower plans and scales monthly costs as your revenue grows. Creator LMS has no transaction fees and no monthly platform fee. You keep full control of your checkout, branding, and student experience.

  • Teachable: $65+/month + transaction fees on lower plans
  • Creator LMS Pro: no monthly fee, no transaction cuts
  • Native Stripe checkout built in — no third-party cart required

Creator LMS vs. LearnDash

LearnDash requires WooCommerce (or a paid add-on) for checkout. Community and cohort learning require separate paid add-ons. There is no built-in AI course generation. Creator LMS Pro bundles native checkout, community, cohorts, and AI course builder at one price.

  • LearnDash: $199/year base + WooCommerce + paid add-ons for community and cohorts
  • Creator LMS Pro: all features included, native checkout, no WooCommerce dependency
  • Free one-click migration from LearnDash is built in

Creator LMS vs. Tutor LMS

Tutor LMS has a similar feature set at the base level, but requires WooCommerce for full checkout functionality. Creator LMS has fully native checkout built in — no WooCommerce needed.

  • Tutor LMS: requires WooCommerce for checkout
  • Creator LMS: native Stripe checkout, no WooCommerce dependency
  • Free one-click migration from Tutor LMS is built in

Creator LMS vs. LearnPress

LearnPress is lightweight and free, but lacks cohort learning, community features, AI course generation, and a native checkout. Scaling up requires multiple paid add-ons. Creator LMS Pro covers all of this at one price.

  • Free one-click migration from LearnPress is built in

Creator LMS vs. MasterStudy LMS

MasterStudy LMS offers solid course creation features but requires WooCommerce for payments and lacks built-in cohort learning, community, and AI course generation. Creator LMS Pro bundles all of these natively.

  • MasterStudy LMS: WooCommerce-dependent checkout, no built-in cohorts or community
  • Creator LMS Pro: native checkout, cohort learning, community platform, and AI course builder included
  • Free one-click migration from MasterStudy LMS is built in

Free Migration from Your Current LMS

Already using another LMS? Switch to Creator LMS with free built-in one-click migration from:

  • LearnDash
  • Tutor LMS
  • LearnPress
  • MasterStudy LMS

Migration is non-destructive. Your original data stays intact until you confirm everything transferred correctly.

🏗️ Course Builder for Coaches

Create and sell coaching courses in minutes with Creator LMS’s drag-and-drop course builder — no technical skills required.

Lesson Types
– Video Lessons — Self-hosted, YouTube, or Vimeo. Custom branded player removes platform branding, recommendations, and watermarks.
– Audio Lessons — Podcast-style lessons or guided audio coaching
– Text Lessons — Rich text with formatting, images, and embeds
– Downloadable Resources — PDFs, worksheets, templates, swipe files

Course Organization
Unlimited chapters, drag-and-drop lesson ordering, course prerequisites, lesson preview for non-enrolled students, and multiple professionally designed course layout templates.

AI-Powered Course Creation
Describe your coaching niche and target student — AI generates a complete course outline with chapters, lessons, and learning objectives in minutes.

🎓 Cohort-Based Learning — Run Group Coaching Programs

Transform your coaching programs into cohort experiences where students start together, learn together, and complete together.

Perfect for:
– High-ticket group coaching programs
– Mastermind and accountability courses
– Bootcamp-style intensives
– Live workshop series
– Corporate training sessions

Cohort features:
– Set start and end dates per cohort
– Run multiple cohorts per course year-round
– Cohort-specific announcements and content schedules
– Live session scheduling inside cohort timelines
– Track progress across an entire cohort
– Manage waitlists for upcoming cohorts

Cohort-based programs see 3–5x higher completion rates compared to self-paced courses. Higher completion = better results for students = stronger testimonials and referrals for your coaching business.

🏘️ Built-In Community Platform for Coaches

Keep students engaged between lessons with a fully integrated community — no BuddyPress, no Circle, no separate subscription.

Community features:
– Course-specific discussion forums
– Student Q&A sections with instructor responses
– Member profiles with achievements and course progress
– No third-party community plugins needed

Active communities drive 70%+ higher course completion rates. When students connect with peers, ask questions, and share wins, they stay engaged longer and get better results from your coaching.

🧩 Quiz & Assessment System

Test student knowledge with a flexible quiz builder supporting 6+ question types.

  • Multiple Choice and Single Choice
  • True / False
  • Fill in the Blank
  • Short Answer and Essay
  • Matching and Reorder
  • Quiz timers and attempt limits
  • Automatic grading for objective questions
  • Manual grading for essays and short answers
  • Detailed quiz result reports with explanations
  • Retake options and controls

📜 Certificates & Credentials

Issue branded completion certificates that students can download, share on LinkedIn, and use as credentials.

  • Custom certificate templates with your branding and logo
  • Automatic generation when students meet completion requirements
  • Unique verification code per certificate
  • PDF download for students
  • Set custom completion criteria (lessons + quiz pass rates)

💳 Native eCommerce — Sell Coaching Programs Without WooCommerce

Creator LMS includes a complete native checkout system built for selling coaching courses and programs — no WooCommerce required.

Free: Stripe, Mollie, offline payments
Pro: PayPal, Razorpay, Authorize.net

Pricing models:
– One-time course purchases
– Subscription and membership pricing
– Installment payment plans (Pro)
– Free courses with upsell offers
– Coupon codes and discounts
– Course bundles and packages

Order management, refunds, and revenue reports live inside Creator LMS. No WooCommerce orders, no plugin conflicts.

💸 One-Click Upsells & Down-sells (Pro)

Increase average order value by 30–50% with native one-click offers — no funnel builder plugins needed.

After a student purchases a course, present a one-click upsell offer. They accept with one click (no re-entering payment details) or decline. If they decline, present a down-sell at a lower price point.

Upsell strategies for coaches:
– Beginner course → Advanced coaching program
– Self-paced course → Cohort group coaching access
– Single course → Full coaching membership
– Free course → Paid program

Track offer acceptance rates and total upsell revenue from your dashboard.

💎 Memberships & Subscriptions (Pro)

Create recurring revenue with coaching memberships — monthly, yearly, or custom billing cycles.

  • Member-only course access
  • Automatic renewal and cancellation handling
  • Subscription analytics
  • Tiered membership levels (coming soon)

🎮 Gamification — Keep Students Engaged

Boost course completion rates by making learning rewarding.

  • Achievement badges for course milestones
  • Leaderboards ranked by points or completion
  • Points for lessons, quizzes, and community posts
  • Learning levels (Beginner → Expert)
  • Milestone rewards (discount codes, bonus access)

🤖 AI Course Builder (Pro)

Generate complete coaching courses in hours, not weeks.

  • AI-powered course outline generation (OpenAI GPT-4 or Anthropic Claude)
  • Course thumbnail and graphic generation
  • AI-assisted curriculum design for your coaching niche

Describe your coaching topic, target audience, and expertise level. AI creates a structured course plan with chapters, lessons, and learning objectives — you add your unique methodology and expertise.

📧 Email Automation

Free — Transactional emails included:
– Course enrollment confirmation
– Course completion congratulations
– Certificate delivery
– Quiz completion notification
– Purchase confirmation and receipt
– Password reset

Pro — Behavior-based automation:
– Started course but didn’t finish lesson 1
– Passed or failed a quiz
– Reached course milestones
– Inactive for 7, 14, or 30 days (re-engagement)
– Progress-triggered drip campaigns
– Mail Mint integration for advanced segmentation and automation

📊 Analytics & Reporting

  • Student progress and completion tracking
  • Course completion rates
  • Quiz performance by question
  • Revenue and sales trends
  • Enrollment statistics
  • Student engagement metrics
  • Instructor earnings reports

🔌 Integrations & Compatibility

Page Builders: Gutenberg, Elementor, Bricks Builder, WPBakery

Payment Gateways: Stripe (free), Mollie (free), Offline (free), PayPal (Pro), Razorpay (Pro), Authorize.net (Pro)

Email & CRM: Mail Mint (Pro), WP Fusion (Pro), Webhooks for Zapier and Make

Other: SCORM import, WordPress Multisite, WPML, Loco Translate, Weglot, 30+ WordPress themes

🔄 Migrate to Creator LMS — Free

Already using another LMS? Switch to Creator LMS in minutes with built-in free migration tools.

Migrate from:
– LearnDash — Course structure, quizzes, student enrollments and progress
– Tutor LMS — Courses, lessons, quizzes, student data
– LearnPress — Full data import including enrollments and progress
– Any SCORM LMS — Import SCORM-compliant course packages

What migrates: Course structure, lesson content, quiz questions and answers, student enrollments, progress data, course settings.

Migration is non-destructive. Your old LMS data stays intact until you’re confident everything transferred correctly. Free migration support from our team if you run into issues.

🌐 Multilingual & RTL Support

  • Fully translatable (.pot files included)
  • Spanish language included
  • RTL support (Arabic, Hebrew, Persian)
  • WPML compatible
  • Works with Loco Translate, Weglot, TranslatePress

⭐ What Coaches Are Saying

Creator LMS has a 100% five-star rating on WordPress.org.

“Best LMS for coaches” — Simple enough for beginners, powerful enough to scale a real coaching business.

“Everything in one plugin” — No need to buy 5 add-ons to get features Creator LMS includes out of the box.

“Native checkout is a game-changer” — No WooCommerce, no complexity — just sell my coaching programs.

👉 Read all reviews | Leave a review

If Creator LMS has helped your coaching business, please take 2 minutes to leave a review. It helps other coaches find the plugin and helps us keep improving it. 🙏

Privacy Policy

Creator LMS uses OpenPanel to collect anonymous usage data — only with your explicit permission during plugin setup.

What we collect (if you opt-in): WordPress version, PHP version, plugin version, active plugin count, anonymized feature usage.

We never collect: personal information, student data, course content, or payment data. We never sell data to third parties. Collection is 100% optional — opt-out anytime.
sections.installation:
1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
  3. Search for “Creator LMS”
  4. Click “Install Now”
  5. Click “Activate”
  6. Follow the setup wizard to configure your coaching LMS
sections.faq:
What is the best WordPress LMS plugin for coaches?

Creator LMS is built specifically for coaches, consultants, and course creators. It includes cohort-based learning for group coaching programs, a built-in community platform, AI course builder, coaching memberships and subscriptions, and one-click upsells — all the features coaching businesses need, bundled at one price. The free version includes unlimited courses, native Stripe checkout, quizzes, and certificates.

Is Creator LMS free?

Yes. The core Creator LMS plugin is 100% free and includes unlimited courses, lessons, students, native Stripe and Mollie checkout, quiz builder, certificate builder, and basic analytics. No credit card. No time limit. Pro adds cohorts, community, AI, gamification, memberships, and advanced monetization.

Is Creator LMS a good Kajabi alternative?

Yes. Creator LMS is the best Kajabi alternative for WordPress coaches. Kajabi charges $149–$399/month plus revenue sharing. Creator LMS is a one-time Pro investment on your own WordPress site — no monthly fees, no transaction cuts, and your student data stays 100% yours. You get cohort-based learning, community platform, AI course generation, and one-click upsells — the same features Kajabi charges hundreds per month for.

Is Creator LMS a good Teachable alternative?

Yes. Teachable charges per-transaction fees on lower plans and monthly fees as you scale. Creator LMS is a Teachable alternative that runs on your WordPress site with no platform fees and no transaction cuts. More control over your checkout, branding, and student experience — at a fraction of the long-term cost.

How does Creator LMS compare to LearnDash?

Creator LMS vs LearnDash: Creator LMS includes native Stripe checkout without WooCommerce — LearnDash requires WooCommerce or a paid add-on for checkout. Creator LMS Pro bundles community, cohort-based learning, AI course generation, and gamification at one price — LearnDash requires separate paid add-ons for each. Creator LMS also includes free one-click migration from LearnDash.

Can I run group coaching programs with Creator LMS?

Yes. Creator LMS Pro includes cohort-based learning designed specifically for group coaching programs. Create a cohort with a start date, enroll students, and they progress through your coaching curriculum together on a shared schedule. Run multiple cohorts per course throughout the year. Schedule live sessions, set content release dates, and send cohort-specific announcements. Cohort-based programs see 3–5x higher completion rates than self-paced courses.

Do I need WooCommerce to sell coaching programs?

No. Creator LMS includes a fully native checkout powered by Stripe and Mollie — WooCommerce is never needed. Students purchase your coaching programs in a streamlined two-step checkout. Manage all orders, refunds, and revenue reports entirely inside Creator LMS.

Can I sell coaching memberships and subscriptions?

Yes, with Creator LMS Pro. Create monthly or yearly subscription plans that give access to your full coaching course library, community, and new content drops. Subscription renewal, cancellation, and access control are all automatic.

Can I build a coaching community without BuddyPress?

Yes. Creator LMS Pro includes a fully built-in community platform — discussion forums, Q&A sections, student profiles, direct messaging, and moderation tools. No BuddyPress, no Circle, no extra plugins or subscriptions needed.

Can I use AI to build my coaching courses?

Yes. Creator LMS Pro includes an AI course builder that generates complete course outlines from your coaching topic description. Supports OpenAI (GPT-4) and Anthropic (Claude) models. Generate course plans, lesson outlines, and quiz questions in minutes — then add your unique coaching methodology and expertise.

Can I migrate from LearnDash to Creator LMS?

Yes. Creator LMS includes free one-click migration from LearnDash. Course structure, quiz data, and student enrollments all transfer automatically. Migration is non-destructive — your LearnDash data stays intact until you’re confident everything migrated correctly. Free migration support from our team is available if needed.

Can I migrate from Tutor LMS to Creator LMS?

Yes. Creator LMS includes free one-click migration from Tutor LMS. Import courses, lessons, quizzes, student progress, and enrollments with a single click.

Can I migrate from Teachable or Kajabi to Creator LMS?

Creator LMS doesn’t have a direct one-click import from SaaS platforms like Teachable or Kajabi, since those platforms don’t export in a standard format. However, our support team can help you plan and execute a migration to Creator LMS. Courses, content, and student data can typically be rebuilt and re-imported. Contact us for migration assistance.

Can I offer free coaching courses as lead magnets?

Yes. Create free introductory courses to build your audience and email list, then use one-click upsell offers to convert free students into paid coaching clients. This lead-magnet-to-upsell funnel is a proven strategy for coaching businesses and is fully supported natively in Creator LMS.

Does Creator LMS work for corporate coaching and team training?

Yes. Creator LMS supports multiple instructors, bulk student enrollment, progress tracking per student, and completion certificates. You can create internal training programs, track team learning, and generate reports — everything needed for corporate coaching delivery.

What payment methods can I use to sell coaching programs?

Free: Stripe (credit/debit cards), Mollie (European payment methods), offline/manual payments. Pro adds PayPal, Authorize.net, and Razorpay for global payment flexibility.

Can I create quizzes and assessments for my coaching courses?

Yes. Creator LMS supports 6+ question types: multiple choice, true/false, fill in the blank, short answer, essay, and matching. Set time limits, attempt limits, and pass/fail thresholds. Objective questions grade automatically; essays grade manually.

Does Creator LMS support video lessons for coaches?

Yes. Upload self-hosted videos or use YouTube and Vimeo URLs. All videos play through Creator LMS’s custom branded player — YouTube recommendations, Vimeo watermarks, and platform branding are removed. Students see only your content.

Is Creator LMS mobile-friendly for students?

Yes. Creator LMS is fully responsive on mobile browsers. Students can access coaching courses, complete lessons, take quizzes, and engage in community on any device. A dedicated iOS and Android app is on the development roadmap for Q2 2026.

How do I get support?

Free users get community forum support at WordPress.org. Pro users get priority email support with faster response times. Visit documentation or the support forum.

Where do I report security bugs?

Report security bugs through the Patchstack Vulnerability Disclosure Program. The Patchstack team handles verification, CVE assignment, and developer notification.

Is my students’ data secure?

Yes. All student data is stored in your own WordPress database on your hosting account. No student data is sent to third-party servers (except payment data processed by your chosen payment gateway). Regular security updates ship with every release. Creator LMS participates in the Patchstack Vulnerability Disclosure Program.

short_description: Best free WordPress LMS for coaches & course creators. Cohort learning, community & native Stripe checkout built in — no WooCommerce needed.
description:
Creator LMS is the best free WordPress LMS plugin for coaches, consultants, and online course creators. Launch group coaching programs, sell courses, and build an engaged learning community — all inside WordPress, with zero monthly fees and no WooCommerce required.

Trusted by 100+ coaches and educators worldwide. Rated ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5 stars on WordPress.org.

The core plugin is 100% free forever — unlimited courses, unlimited students, native Stripe checkout, quizzes, and certificates included at no cost.

🚀 Live Demo | 📘 Documentation | 🎥 Video Tutorials | 🎬 Setup Tutorial | 💁‍♂️ Facebook Community | 🗺️ Roadmap

Why Coaches Choose Creator LMS

Most WordPress LMS plugins are built for universities and corporate training. Creator LMS is built for coaches who need to sell, scale, and engage — without complex tech or expensive monthly platforms.

Creator LMS is the go-to WordPress coaching plugin for:

  • 🧑‍💼 Life coaches selling 1:1 and group programs
  • 💼 Business coaches running cohort-based masterminds
  • 💪 Fitness & health coaches running subscription programs
  • 🎓 Online educators building course libraries
  • 🤝 Consultants packaging expertise into sellable courses
  • 🏢 Agencies building LMS sites for clients

Six reasons coaches pick Creator LMS over everything else:

  1. Cohort-based learning (Pro) — Students start together, progress together. Creates accountability, higher completion, and justifies premium pricing.
  2. Built-in community (Pro) — Students connect, ask questions, and support each other — no BuddyPress, no Facebook Groups.
  3. AI course builder (Pro) — Describe your coaching topic and AI generates a complete course outline in minutes.
  4. Native checkout — Sell coaching programs with Stripe or Mollie. No WooCommerce. No cart abandonment.
  5. Memberships & subscriptions (Pro) — Monthly or yearly coaching memberships for predictable recurring revenue.
  6. One-click upsells (Pro) — Increase revenue per student with post-purchase upsell offers, no redirect needed.

🎯 Popular Use Cases for Coaches

Group Coaching Programs
Run structured group coaching with cohorts — students enroll, start on a set date, and move through your curriculum as a group. Perfect for high-ticket coaching offers.

Self-Paced Online Coaching Courses
Package your coaching methodology into a self-paced course. Students access lessons anytime, complete quizzes, and earn certificates to share.

Coaching Memberships
Monthly or yearly memberships that unlock your full course library, community access, and new content drops. Predictable recurring revenue without per-sale hustle.

Bootcamp & Workshop Programs
Intensive time-limited programs with cohorts, live session scheduling, and community discussion for peer accountability and support.

Free Lead Magnet Courses
Offer a free introductory course to build your email list, then convert students to paid coaching programs with one-click upsell offers.

Corporate & Team Training
Deliver employee training for business clients. Track team progress, issue completion certificates, and manage bulk enrollments.

🆓 Best Free WordPress LMS Plugin

Creator LMS offers more in its free version than most paid WordPress LMS plugins. No trial. No credit card. Free forever.

Free version includes:
– ✅ Unlimited courses, lessons, and students
– ✅ Native Stripe and Mollie checkout — no WooCommerce
– ✅ Quiz builder with 6+ question types
– ✅ Certificate builder with verification
– ✅ Gutenberg, Elementor, and Bricks Builder support
– ✅ Multiple lesson types (video, audio, text, downloads)
– ✅ Student progress tracking and analytics
– ✅ Course categories, tags, and prerequisites
– ✅ Custom video player (removes YouTube/Vimeo branding)
– ✅ Student dashboard and profile management

Creator LMS Pro unlocks:
– Cohort-based learning for group coaching programs
– Built-in community platform
– AI course builder
– Gamification (badges, leaderboards, points)
– One-click upsells and down-sells
– Memberships and subscriptions
– Advanced email automation (Mail Mint)
– Content protection (screen recording prevention)
– Additional payment gateways (PayPal, Razorpay, Authorize.net)
– Advanced analytics and reporting

Creator LMS vs. Kajabi, Teachable, LearnDash & More

The best Kajabi and Teachable alternative for WordPress coaches and course creators.

Kajabi costs $149–$399/month and takes a revenue cut. Teachable charges per transaction. Creator LMS runs on your own WordPress site — one-time Pro cost, zero revenue share, 100% data ownership.

Creator LMS vs. Kajabi

Kajabi charges $149–$399/month forever, plus revenue sharing on lower plans. Creator LMS is a one-time Pro purchase on your own WordPress site. You get cohort-based learning, a built-in community platform, AI course generation, and one-click upsells — everything Kajabi offers, without the monthly platform fee or data lock-in.

  • Kajabi: $149–$399/month + revenue share
  • Creator LMS Pro: one-time cost, no revenue share
  • Your student data stays on your own server — not locked in a SaaS platform

Creator LMS vs. Teachable

Teachable charges per-transaction fees on lower plans and scales monthly costs as your revenue grows. Creator LMS has no transaction fees and no monthly platform fee. You keep full control of your checkout, branding, and student experience.

  • Teachable: $65+/month + transaction fees on lower plans
  • Creator LMS Pro: no monthly fee, no transaction cuts
  • Native Stripe checkout built in — no third-party cart required

Creator LMS vs. LearnDash

LearnDash requires WooCommerce (or a paid add-on) for checkout. Community and cohort learning require separate paid add-ons. There is no built-in AI course generation. Creator LMS Pro bundles native checkout, community, cohorts, and AI course builder at one price.

  • LearnDash: $199/year base + WooCommerce + paid add-ons for community and cohorts
  • Creator LMS Pro: all features included, native checkout, no WooCommerce dependency
  • Free one-click migration from LearnDash is built in

Creator LMS vs. Tutor LMS

Tutor LMS has a similar feature set at the base level, but requires WooCommerce for full checkout functionality. Creator LMS has fully native checkout built in — no WooCommerce needed.

  • Tutor LMS: requires WooCommerce for checkout
  • Creator LMS: native Stripe checkout, no WooCommerce dependency
  • Free one-click migration from Tutor LMS is built in

Creator LMS vs. LearnPress

LearnPress is lightweight and free, but lacks cohort learning, community features, AI course generation, and a native checkout. Scaling up requires multiple paid add-ons. Creator LMS Pro covers all of this at one price.

  • Free one-click migration from LearnPress is built in

Creator LMS vs. MasterStudy LMS

MasterStudy LMS offers solid course creation features but requires WooCommerce for payments and lacks built-in cohort learning, community, and AI course generation. Creator LMS Pro bundles all of these natively.

  • MasterStudy LMS: WooCommerce-dependent checkout, no built-in cohorts or community
  • Creator LMS Pro: native checkout, cohort learning, community platform, and AI course builder included
  • Free one-click migration from MasterStudy LMS is built in

Free Migration from Your Current LMS

Already using another LMS? Switch to Creator LMS with free built-in one-click migration from:

  • LearnDash
  • Tutor LMS
  • LearnPress
  • MasterStudy LMS

Migration is non-destructive. Your original data stays intact until you confirm everything transferred correctly.

🏗️ Course Builder for Coaches

Create and sell coaching courses in minutes with Creator LMS’s drag-and-drop course builder — no technical skills required.

Lesson Types
– Video Lessons — Self-hosted, YouTube, or Vimeo. Custom branded player removes platform branding, recommendations, and watermarks.
– Audio Lessons — Podcast-style lessons or guided audio coaching
– Text Lessons — Rich text with formatting, images, and embeds
– Downloadable Resources — PDFs, worksheets, templates, swipe files

Course Organization
Unlimited chapters, drag-and-drop lesson ordering, course prerequisites, lesson preview for non-enrolled students, and multiple professionally designed course layout templates.

AI-Powered Course Creation
Describe your coaching niche and target student — AI generates a complete course outline with chapters, lessons, and learning objectives in minutes.

🎓 Cohort-Based Learning — Run Group Coaching Programs

Transform your coaching programs into cohort experiences where students start together, learn together, and complete together.

Perfect for:
– High-ticket group coaching programs
– Mastermind and accountability courses
– Bootcamp-style intensives
– Live workshop series
– Corporate training sessions

Cohort features:
– Set start and end dates per cohort
– Run multiple cohorts per course year-round
– Cohort-specific announcements and content schedules
– Live session scheduling inside cohort timelines
– Track progress across an entire cohort
– Manage waitlists for upcoming cohorts

Cohort-based programs see 3–5x higher completion rates compared to self-paced courses. Higher completion = better results for students = stronger testimonials and referrals for your coaching business.

🏘️ Built-In Community Platform for Coaches

Keep students engaged between lessons with a fully integrated community — no BuddyPress, no Circle, no separate subscription.

Community features:
– Course-specific discussion forums
– Student Q&A sections with instructor responses
– Member profiles with achievements and course progress
– No third-party community plugins needed

Active communities drive 70%+ higher course completion rates. When students connect with peers, ask questions, and share wins, they stay engaged longer and get better results from your coaching.

🧩 Quiz & Assessment System

Test student knowledge with a flexible quiz builder supporting 6+ question types.

  • Multiple Choice and Single Choice
  • True / False
  • Fill in the Blank
  • Short Answer and Essay
  • Matching and Reorder
  • Quiz timers and attempt limits
  • Automatic grading for objective questions
  • Manual grading for essays and short answers
  • Detailed quiz result reports with explanations
  • Retake options and controls

📜 Certificates & Credentials

Issue branded completion certificates that students can download, share on LinkedIn, and use as credentials.

  • Custom certificate templates with your branding and logo
  • Automatic generation when students meet completion requirements
  • Unique verification code per certificate
  • PDF download for students
  • Set custom completion criteria (lessons + quiz pass rates)

💳 Native eCommerce — Sell Coaching Programs Without WooCommerce

Creator LMS includes a complete native checkout system built for selling coaching courses and programs — no WooCommerce required.

Free: Stripe, Mollie, offline payments
Pro: PayPal, Razorpay, Authorize.net

Pricing models:
– One-time course purchases
– Subscription and membership pricing
– Installment payment plans (Pro)
– Free courses with upsell offers
– Coupon codes and discounts
– Course bundles and packages

Order management, refunds, and revenue reports live inside Creator LMS. No WooCommerce orders, no plugin conflicts.

💸 One-Click Upsells & Down-sells (Pro)

Increase average order value by 30–50% with native one-click offers — no funnel builder plugins needed.

After a student purchases a course, present a one-click upsell offer. They accept with one click (no re-entering payment details) or decline. If they decline, present a down-sell at a lower price point.

Upsell strategies for coaches:
– Beginner course → Advanced coaching program
– Self-paced course → Cohort group coaching access
– Single course → Full coaching membership
– Free course → Paid program

Track offer acceptance rates and total upsell revenue from your dashboard.

💎 Memberships & Subscriptions (Pro)

Create recurring revenue with coaching memberships — monthly, yearly, or custom billing cycles.

  • Member-only course access
  • Automatic renewal and cancellation handling
  • Subscription analytics
  • Tiered membership levels (coming soon)

🎮 Gamification — Keep Students Engaged

Boost course completion rates by making learning rewarding.

  • Achievement badges for course milestones
  • Leaderboards ranked by points or completion
  • Points for lessons, quizzes, and community posts
  • Learning levels (Beginner → Expert)
  • Milestone rewards (discount codes, bonus access)

🤖 AI Course Builder (Pro)

Generate complete coaching courses in hours, not weeks.

  • AI-powered course outline generation (OpenAI GPT-4 or Anthropic Claude)
  • Course thumbnail and graphic generation
  • AI-assisted curriculum design for your coaching niche

Describe your coaching topic, target audience, and expertise level. AI creates a structured course plan with chapters, lessons, and learning objectives — you add your unique methodology and expertise.

📧 Email Automation

Free — Transactional emails included:
– Course enrollment confirmation
– Course completion congratulations
– Certificate delivery
– Quiz completion notification
– Purchase confirmation and receipt
– Password reset

Pro — Behavior-based automation:
– Started course but didn’t finish lesson 1
– Passed or failed a quiz
– Reached course milestones
– Inactive for 7, 14, or 30 days (re-engagement)
– Progress-triggered drip campaigns
– Mail Mint integration for advanced segmentation and automation

📊 Analytics & Reporting

  • Student progress and completion tracking
  • Course completion rates
  • Quiz performance by question
  • Revenue and sales trends
  • Enrollment statistics
  • Student engagement metrics
  • Instructor earnings reports

🔌 Integrations & Compatibility

Page Builders: Gutenberg, Elementor, Bricks Builder, WPBakery

Payment Gateways: Stripe (free), Mollie (free), Offline (free), PayPal (Pro), Razorpay (Pro), Authorize.net (Pro)

Email & CRM: Mail Mint (Pro), WP Fusion (Pro), Webhooks for Zapier and Make

Other: SCORM import, WordPress Multisite, WPML, Loco Translate, Weglot, 30+ WordPress themes

🔄 Migrate to Creator LMS — Free

Already using another LMS? Switch to Creator LMS in minutes with built-in free migration tools.

Migrate from:
– LearnDash — Course structure, quizzes, student enrollments and progress
– Tutor LMS — Courses, lessons, quizzes, student data
– LearnPress — Full data import including enrollments and progress
– Any SCORM LMS — Import SCORM-compliant course packages

What migrates: Course structure, lesson content, quiz questions and answers, student enrollments, progress data, course settings.

Migration is non-destructive. Your old LMS data stays intact until you’re confident everything transferred correctly. Free migration support from our team if you run into issues.

🌐 Multilingual & RTL Support

  • Fully translatable (.pot files included)
  • Spanish language included
  • RTL support (Arabic, Hebrew, Persian)
  • WPML compatible
  • Works with Loco Translate, Weglot, TranslatePress

⭐ What Coaches Are Saying

Creator LMS has a 100% five-star rating on WordPress.org.

“Best LMS for coaches” — Simple enough for beginners, powerful enough to scale a real coaching business.

“Everything in one plugin” — No need to buy 5 add-ons to get features Creator LMS includes out of the box.

“Native checkout is a game-changer” — No WooCommerce, no complexity — just sell my coaching programs.

👉 Read all reviews | Leave a review

If Creator LMS has helped your coaching business, please take 2 minutes to leave a review. It helps other coaches find the plugin and helps us keep improving it. 🙏

Privacy Policy

Creator LMS uses OpenPanel to collect anonymous usage data — only with your explicit permission during plugin setup.

What we collect (if you opt-in): WordPress version, PHP version, plugin version, active plugin count, anonymized feature usage.

We never collect: personal information, student data, course content, or payment data. We never sell data to third parties. Collection is 100% optional — opt-out anytime.
